# DAO Studio

> Make AI useful through composed applications, coordinated response and capabilities others can build upon.



## Start here

- [DAO Studio](https://daostudio.in/index.md) ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/))

- [Thoughts](https://daostudio.in/collections/index.md): Three inquiries from the studio's products: how an incident is carried from request to response, how people join an application while it is working and what a capability must preserve to serve another team. Standalone essays are on the Blog. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/collections/))

- [Blog](https://daostudio.in/blog/index.md): Composition, feedback, response and the questions behind DAO Studio's work. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/blog/))

- [About DAO Studio](https://daostudio.in/about/index.md): How an ambition to help people create decentralised, autonomous organisations became three ways to make AI capability useful. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/about/))


## Projects and products

- [DAOnet](https://daostudio.in/daonet/index.md): Build on another team’s AI capability with its context, version and agreed use understood across applications. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/daonet/))

- [YOJN Care](https://daostudio.in/yojn-care/index.md): Connect personal requests, camera evidence and human review so an incident can become a continuing response. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/yojn-care/))

- [YojnAI](https://daostudio.in/yojnai/index.md): Compose AI applications people can inspect, guide and improve, connecting models and tools to real organisational work. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/yojnai/))


## Collections

- [Composing AI work](https://daostudio.in/collections/composing-ai-work/index.md): The context, traces, feedback and versions around a model-driven application. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/collections/composing-ai-work/))

- [Coordinating emergencies](https://daostudio.in/collections/coordinating-emergencies/index.md): The interface, evidence path, evaluation and continuing work behind an emergency response. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/collections/coordinating-emergencies/))

- [Protocols and reuse](https://daostudio.in/collections/protocols-and-reuse/index.md): What shared AI capabilities must preserve, and what decentralisation would actually add. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/collections/protocols-and-reuse/))


## Reading journeys

- [From composition to a deliberate change](https://daostudio.in/collections/composing-ai-work/from-composition-to-a-deliberate-change/index.md): Application units, the execution record and a version change chosen on purpose. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/collections/composing-ai-work/from-composition-to-a-deliberate-change/))

- [A court before the consequence](https://daostudio.in/collections/protocols-and-reuse/a-court-before-the-consequence/index.md): From a judgment people can contest to the release of the version it examined and the common record of both. ([HTML](https://daostudio.in/collections/protocols-and-reuse/a-court-before-the-consequence/))
